prediction.text:
Microsoft attributed the lower Microsoft Cloud gross margin in FY2025 to scaling its AI infrastructure, partly offset by efficiency gains in Azure. The evidence has no Microsoft Cloud revenue figure and no prior-year Microsoft Cloud margin. So I could not measure cloud sales growth or the size of the cloud margin decline. Company-wide, revenue grew 14.93% and gross margin fell about 0.94 percentage points, from 69.76% to 68.82%. Company-wide operating margin rose about 0.98 percentage points, so the margin squeeze shows up in gross margin, not operating margin.
Microsoft's FY2025 10-K says the Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage decreased to 69%, driven by the impact of scaling its AI infrastructure, offset in part by efficiency gains in Azure.
In its Economic Conditions, Challenges and Risks discussion, Microsoft said the investments it is making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase its operating costs and may decrease its operating margins.
Separately, in the results overview, Microsoft said cost of revenue increased $13.7 billion or 19% driven by growth in Microsoft Cloud.
Company-wide revenue grew about 14.93% in FY2025, to $281.72 billion from $245.12 billion. This is total company revenue, not cloud-only.
Company-wide gross margin was about 69.76% in FY2024.
Company-wide gross margin was about 68.82% in FY2025.
Company-wide gross margin fell about 0.94 percentage points in FY2025 while revenue grew.
Company-wide operating margin rose about 0.98 percentage points, from 44.64% to 45.62%. The squeeze appears in gross margin but not in company-wide operating margin.

caveats: The evidence has no Microsoft Cloud revenue figure, so cloud sales growth is not verified. Company-wide revenue growth is shown instead.

The evidence has no prior-year Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage, so the size of the cloud margin decline is not quantified. Only the 69% FY2025 level and its stated driver come from the filing text.
The gross margin and operating margin calculations are company-wide, not cloud-only.
